title: 雨つぶ連花
concept: 雨をひと粒落として芽を育て、4枚で開花すると隣の芽も育つ。雨は庭ごとに6粒だけ。3枚の芽をどの順で咲かせるか読み、連鎖が広がる瞬間と、残った芽を最後に咲かせる判断を核にした60秒のパズル。
howToPlay: 芽をタップして花びらを1枚増やします。4枚で開花し、上下左右にも1枚ずつ広がります。庭ごとの雨6粒で大きな連鎖を狙いましょう。
libraryDecision: 共有棚のライブラリは使わない。面白さの核は離散的な隣接連鎖と残り雨粒の読み合いで、物理演算や3D化は芽の枚数と隣接関係を読みづらくする。Canvasの段階表示と短いWeb Audio音で、連鎖の進行を明確にする。

en.title: Raindrop Bloom
en.concept: One raindrop grows a bud; four petals make it bloom and grow adjacent buds. Each garden has only six drops. Reading the order of three-petal blooms, watching a chain spread and finishing the remaining buds are the core of this 60-second puzzle.
en.howToPlay: Tap a bud to add a petal. Four petals make it bloom and add a petal to each orthogonal neighbor. Build big chains with six drops per garden.
en.libraryDecision: Use no shelf libraries. The core is discrete neighbor propagation and planning with limited drops; physics and 3D would make petal counts and adjacency harder to read. Canvas stages and brief Web Audio tones communicate the cascade clearly.

aiReview.comment: 11手の画像付きプレイで6連花48点、雨切れの減点と庭の更新、95点での時間切れ、再開始を確認。3枚の芽から連鎖を予測する楽しさはあるが、孤立した芽が残ると6粒では処理が厳しく、初回の快感が続きにくい。致命的な不具合はなく、バランスは変更しない。

similar.title: ChainReaction (jubich)
similar.note: 閾値で上下左右へ1個ずつ伝播する仕組みが近い。こちらは4枚固定で開花後に消え、6粒の単独スコアパズル。原作は隣接数が閾値の多人数陣取り。
similar.note_en: Both cascade one unit to orthogonal neighbors at a threshold. Here four petals remove a bud in a six-drop solo score puzzle; the other uses degree-based thresholds and multiplayer ownership.

similar.title: Chain Reaction (HeliosphereStudio)
similar.note: 連鎖で盤上の要素を消す点は共通。こちらは隣接マスの枚数を読む離散パズルで、相手はドラッグして粒子を衝突させる物理サバイバル。
similar.note_en: Both remove board elements through reactions. This is a discrete neighbor-count puzzle; the other drags particles into collisions in physics survival.

aiReview.research: 4検索（Nintendoの連鎖、itch.ioの水滴連鎖、Splash Backのルール、Chain Reactionの閾値）で探索。実装者のGitHubルールと開発者itch.ioの操作説明を確認し2作品を比較。

en.comment: Eleven image-guided moves confirmed a six-bloom chain worth 48 points, depleted-drop penalty, next garden, timeout at 95 and restart. Predicting chains from three-petal buds is enjoyable, but isolated buds are hard to finish with six drops, making the initial satisfaction difficult to sustain. No fatal bugs; balance was not changed.
en.research: Four queries covered Nintendo chains, itch.io water-drop chains, Splash Back rules, and Chain Reaction thresholds. Compared two games using an implementer GitHub rules page and the developer itch.io instructions.

aiReview.method: スマホ縦画面で 11 手プレイ（時間を止めて1手ずつ操作）
aiReview.methodEn: Played 11 moves on a portrait phone screen (time frozen between moves)

playLog.note: 3行の説明で、4枚から開花して隣にも広がるルールを確認。開始して3枚の芽が集まる場所を探す。
playLog.noteEn: The three-line rules explain four-petal blooms and neighbor propagation. I start to look for clusters of three-petal buds.

playLog.note: 2行目2列目の3枚の芽は、左と右と上にも3枚の芽が隣接。ここへ雨を1粒落とせば大きく連鎖しそう。
playLog.noteEn: The three-petal bud in row two, column two touches three-petal buds above and on both sides. One drop here looks likely to start a large chain.

playLog.note: 雨1粒で6連花、48点。残った3行目2列目の3枚の芽は下にも3枚がある。下側を育てる連鎖を狙う。
playLog.noteEn: One drop produced a six-bloom chain and 48 points. The remaining three-petal bud in row three, column two has another below it. I try a chain through the lower garden.

playLog.note: 58点、雨は4粒。3行目3列目の3枚から右と下に連鎖できそう。2枚だった芽が3枚に育った変化も読み取れる。
playLog.noteEn: Fifty-eight points with four drops left. The three-petal bud in row three, column three can chain right and down. I can read how earlier two-petal buds grew to three.

playLog.note: 右側に残った3枚の芽を開花させ、上の1枚の芽を育てる。離れた芽を雨3粒で片付けられるかを考える。
playLog.noteEn: I bloom the three-petal bud on the right to grow the one-petal bud above it, considering whether three drops can finish the separated buds.

playLog.note: 95点、雨2粒。左の3枚を咲かせるが、離れた2枚の芽は残る。序盤の連鎖後に孤立した芽が難所になる。
playLog.noteEn: At 95 points with two drops, I bloom the left three-petal bud. The separated two-petal buds remain; isolated buds make cleanup difficult after the initial cascade.

playLog.note: 100点、雨1粒では2枚の芽を咲かせられない。最後の雨を右上へ使い、雨切れの減点と次の庭への移行を見る。
playLog.noteEn: At 100 points, one drop cannot bloom the two-petal bud. I use it at the top right and observe the depleted-drop penalty and next garden.

playLog.note: 90点に減点され庭2へ、雨は6粒に補充。右端の3枚の芽を咲かせ、隣の小さい芽の成長を確かめる。
playLog.noteEn: The score fell to 90 and garden two restored six drops. I bloom the three-petal bud at the right edge to check neighboring growth.

playLog.note: 95点で隣接3マスの成長を確認。入力せず待ち、残り時間が進むことを確かめる。
playLog.noteEn: At 95 points, three adjacent cells grew. I wait without input to verify the countdown continues.

playLog.note: 残り24秒、95点。追加入力なしで時間切れまで進め、結果と最高点を確認する。
playLog.noteEn: Twenty-four seconds remain at 95 points. I wait for timeout to inspect the result and best score.

playLog.note: 雨上がりの結果は95点、ベスト更新を表示。もう一度をタップし、得点と時間が初期化されるかを見る。
playLog.noteEn: The result shows 95 points and a new best. I tap again to verify the score and timer reset.

metrics.method: Codexのtoken_usage_recordをresponse_idで重複除去し企画開始から自己判定完了まで集計。入力はキャッシュ込み、出力から思考を控除。ツールはトップレベル呼出のみ（内包呼出は除外）。
metrics.methodEn: Aggregated Codex token_usage_record entries by unique response_id from planning through review. Input includes cached tokens; output excludes reasoning. Tools count top-level calls only, excluding nested calls.
